description: Owner 2026-10-19: sweeps that compile every kernel cost too much time, and known-poor examples get measured again for nothing. Rules: (a) a C-correctness check never needs cc or the whole catalog; (b) every measured result carries a stamp (defk version, commit, C hash of its kernels, date, machine); (c) a stamped result is measured again ONLY on explicit request (owner or a ticket that names the example). Tools report stale rows (C changed since the stamp); they never re-measure on their own. Children: C-only dump_c + agent rule doc; per-row stamp + partial snapshot; stale report.
title: Selective kernel runs: compile and measure only what a change touches
